sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The upper-bow comparison targets the wrong entity and uses an invalid ship-to-frame indirection: hasComponent has shipComponent range and does not provide the required path from the frame to the ship-owned upperBowIceBeltTop. Request or locate the canonical cross-owner path, then compare the frame's framingIceStrengtheningAboveUpperIceWaterline with upperBowIceBeltTop on the supplied ship owner, conditional on upperBowIceBeltRequired=true; do not use hasComponent for this relationship. Also add a direct SHACL constraint for frame-owned reachesTankTopOrBelowFloorTop (xsd:boolean, with appropriate cardinality) because it is a declared direct-constraint operand currently used only inside SPARQL.
